Antimicrobial Action Cefepime is a fourth-generation cephalosporin and is active against a wide range of Gram-positive and Gram-negative aerobic organisms. Against Gram-pos- itive cocci, its activity is similar to that of cefotaxime (p.228) and includes staphylococci (but not meticillin- resistant Staphylococcus aureus) and streptococci.
